About

Chosen slowly.

OPAR is a small independent project built around one idea: the objects and knowledge we keep close should be chosen slowly, and described honestly.

Two fronts, one identity

The shop sells a small number of objects for everyday care. Perennis gives books and music away. The two sit side by side because a shop that only sells, and a library that only lends, each miss something.

Who sells what

Some products are sold by OPAR. Others are partner offers, where the purchase happens with another merchant. Those pages say so before you click, because the seller, the delivery and the returns are not the same.

What OPAR will not do

No invented reviews or ratings. No countdown timers. No health claim a supplier has not evidenced. No certification badge without a document behind it. No book published without a documented right to publish that edition.

Where this is going

The site is being built in the open, section by section. This page will grow into the fuller story as sourcing, makers and the library take shape.
